The Economic Census is the official five-year measure of businesses in the United States providing comprehensive statistics at the national, state, and local levels. ### You May Be Interested In Data Tool My Congressional District Access selected statistics about your Congressional district collected through the American Community Survey (ACS) and County Business Patterns (CBP). Data Tool Census Business Builder (CBB) Census Business Builder offers small business owners selected Census Bureau & other statistics to guide their research for opening or expanding their business. Business and Economy The Census Bureau produces economic data from across the entire U.S. economy on a monthly, quarterly, yearly, and 5-year basis. # Advance Economic Indicators. The Advance Economic Indicators Report provides advance statistics for U.S. International Trade in Goods, domestic retail inventories, and domestic wholesale inventories. The data for U.S. International Trade in Goods are compiled in terms of commodity classification, quantities, values, shipping weights, method of transportation (air or vessel), state of (movement) origin, customs district, customs port, country of destination, and whether contents are domestic goods or re-exports. For Monthly Wholesale Trade and Monthly Retail Trade, entities provide data on dollar values of merchant wholesale end-of-month inventories and retail end-of-month inventories respectively. **Intention to Revise -** Monthly retail estimates are anticipated to be revised based on historical corrections and the results of the 2023 and 2024 Annual Integrated Economic Survey. Revisions to the retail estimates are anticipated to be reflected in the August 2026 Advance Economic Indicators release scheduled for September 30, 2026 at 8:30 a.m. EDT. As a result of this transition and the associated changes to data processing and integration, the Monthly Wholesale Trade Survey (MWTS) annual revisions will be delayed.
